note: 术语库：每条含中文与英文字段；前端按当前语言取用（xxx_en 缺省时退回中文）。

entries.plain: 期末比期初多了多少，按本金算。投入 1 万变成 1.05 万，收益率就是 5%。
entries.analogy: 跟存银行算利息一回事，只是涨跌都可能。
entries.why: 所有绩效数字的起点。
entries.plain_en: How much more you ended up with, as a share of what you put in. 10,000 becoming 10,500 is a 5% return.
entries.analogy_en: Same idea as interest on a bank deposit, except the number can go down.
entries.why_en: The starting point for every performance figure.

entries.plain: 把不同长度的收益折算成『一年多少』，方便横向比较。三年涨了 50%，年化约 14.5%，不是 16.7%，因为要算复利。
entries.analogy: 把『跑完 42 公里用了几小时』换算成配速。
entries.why: 报告第 3 章每一行都用它。
entries.plain_en: Compresses any period into 'per year' so different lengths can be compared. Three years of +50% total is about 14.5% a year, not 16.7%, because of compounding.
entries.analogy_en: Turning 'finished the marathon in 4 hours' into a pace per kilometre.
entries.why_en: Every row of the results table uses it.

entries.plain: 从最高点跌到最低点，最惨的时候亏了多少。账户从 10 万涨到 12 万、又跌到 9 万，最大回撤就是 25%（12 万到 9 万）。
entries.analogy: 不是问你现在赚多少，而是问你最难受的时候能不能扛住不割肉。
entries.why: 决定策略能不能真的拿在手上。
entries.plain_en: The worst peak-to-trough loss. An account going 100k to 120k then 90k has a maximum drawdown of 25% (120k down to 90k).
entries.analogy_en: It does not ask what you made; it asks what you would have had to sit through without selling.
entries.why_en: Decides whether a strategy is actually holdable.

entries.plain: 每承担一份波动，换来多少收益。同样赚 10%，波动小的那个夏普更高。大于 1 算不错，小于 0 意味着还不如放着不动。
entries.analogy: 两条山路都到山顶，一条是缓坡，一条是悬崖边 —— 夏普量的是『这段路有多吓人』。
entries.why: 报告里衡量『值不值这个心惊肉跳』。
entries.plain_en: Return per unit of wobble. Of two strategies making 10%, the steadier one has the higher Sharpe. Above 1 is decent; below 0 means you would have done better doing nothing.
entries.analogy_en: Two mountain paths to the same summit: one gentle, one along a cliff. Sharpe measures how scary the walk was.
entries.why_en: How the results table measures 'was this worth the stress'.

entries.plain: 赚钱的交易占多少比例。但胜率高不等于赚钱：10 笔里 9 笔赚 10 块、1 笔亏 500 块，胜率 90% 照样亏。
entries.analogy: 投篮命中率高，但如果命中的都是 1 分球、投丢的是关键球，还是输。
entries.why: 报告第 3 章有它，但要和收益额一起看。
entries.plain_en: The share of trades that made money. A high hit rate is not profit: nine win 10 and one loses 500 is a 90% hit rate and a loss.
entries.analogy_en: A great free-throw percentage does not win games if the misses are the important shots.
entries.why_en: Shown in the results, but always next to the size of wins and losses.

entries.plain: 用来对照的『什么都不做』版本：同一天买入同一只票，然后一直不动。
entries.analogy: 减肥的对照组：不节食不运动，就看自然变化。
entries.why: 所有策略都必须跟它比，否则牛市里谁都是天才。
entries.plain_en: The 'do nothing' comparison: buy the same thing on the same day and never touch it.
entries.analogy_en: The control group in a diet study.
entries.why_en: Every strategy must be measured against it, otherwise any bull market makes you look like a genius.

entries.plain: 见『基准』。策略要证明的不是『赚了钱』，而是『比躺着不动多赚了』。
entries.why: 本项目判定路径成败的唯一参照物。
entries.plain_en: See benchmark. The claim being tested is not 'it made money' but 'it made more than sitting still'.
entries.why_en: The only reference point this project judges anything against.

entries.plain: 策略的收益减去基准的收益。这部分才算『本事』，剩下的是跟着大盘涨的运气。
entries.analogy: 考试分数减掉班级平均分，才知道你是不是真的比大家强。
entries.why: 判定通过与否，只看超额，不看绝对收益。
entries.plain_en: Strategy return minus benchmark return. Only this part is skill; the rest is market beta you got for free.
entries.analogy_en: Your exam score minus the class average.
entries.why_en: Pass or fail is decided on excess return only, never on absolute return.

entries.plain: 价格晃得有多厉害，通常按一年折算。20% 表示大多数时候一年内上下晃两成。
entries.analogy: 坐在车里的颠簸程度。
entries.why: 决定你晚上睡不睡得着。
entries.plain_en: How violently the price moves, usually annualised. 20% means it typically swings about a fifth within a year.
entries.analogy_en: How bumpy the ride is.
entries.why_en: Decides whether you can sleep while holding it.

entries.plain: 每次买卖都要付给券商的钱，按成交金额比例收。本项目按每边 0.03% 算。
entries.why: 交易越频繁，它吃掉的收益越多。
entries.plain_en: Paid to the broker on every trade, as a percentage of the amount traded. This project assumes 0.03% per side.
entries.why_en: The more you trade, the more of the return it eats.

entries.plain: 你想要的价格和你实际成交的价格之间的差。你想要 10.00，成交在 10.02，滑点就是 0.02。
entries.analogy: 外卖标价 30，加上配送费到手 32 —— 那 2 块就是滑点。
entries.why: 本项目按每边 0.05% 算，双边加起来 0.16%。
entries.plain_en: The gap between the price you wanted and the price you got. Wanted 10.00, filled at 10.02: 0.02 of slippage.
entries.analogy_en: Listed price 30, checkout 32 after fees: those 2 are slippage.
entries.why_en: Assumed at 0.05% per side here, giving 0.16% round trip with commission.

entries.plain: A 股卖出时国家收的税，目前 0.05%。买入不收，只收卖出。
entries.why: 本项目的 v1 没有计入，报告里会写明，所以 A 股的实际收益会再低一点。
entries.plain_en: A tax on selling A-shares (0.05%). Buying has none.
entries.why_en: v1 of this project does not include it, so real A-share returns are slightly worse than reported.

entries.plain: 公司分红送股时，股价会出现一个『断口』（比如 10 送 10，价格直接腰斩）。复权就是把这个断口抹平，让历史价格可以连续比较。
entries.analogy: 把不同货币的价格先换成同一种货币，才能比较。
entries.why: 不复权的话，均线会在除权日突然跳空，产生一堆假信号。
entries.plain_en: When a company pays a dividend or splits, the price series gets a step change (10-for-10 halves the price). Adjustment removes that step so history is comparable.
entries.analogy_en: Converting prices into one currency before comparing them.
entries.why_en: Without it, a moving average sees a fake gap on the ex-date and fires a false signal.

entries.plain: 保持现在的价格不变，把历史价格往低处调。看盘最顺，但每次分红都会重算历史价格。
entries.why: 本项目早期用过，后来发现拉长到 10 年会算出负价格。
entries.plain_en: Keeps today's price and scales history down. Looks right on a chart, but every new dividend rewrites the past.
entries.why_en: Used early in this project; over ten years on high-dividend names it produced negative prices.

entries.plain: 保持历史价格不变，把现在的价格放大。适合算长期真实收益。
entries.why: 本项目现在长历史一律用它 —— 前复权在长历史高分红股上会算出负数。
entries.plain_en: Keeps history fixed and scales today's price up. The right choice for long-run return calculation.
entries.why_en: All long history here uses it, because forward adjustment went negative.

entries.plain: 只看活到今天的样本。用『今天还在的大公司』去回测过去，等于提前知道谁赢了。
entries.analogy: 研究『怎么活到 90 岁』时只采访活着的老人，会漏掉所有早逝的。
entries.why: 本项目最容易造出假优势的陷阱：12 只名票上动量有效，扩到 59 只含跑输票后立刻消失。
entries.plain_en: Only looking at what survived. Backtesting on 'companies still listed today' means you already know who won.
entries.analogy_en: Studying 'how to live to 90' by interviewing only people who are alive.
entries.why_en: The easiest way to invent a fake edge: momentum looked good on 12 famous names (IC +0.063) and vanished once 59 names including losers were used.

entries.plain: 只用当时真的能看到的信息。今天的成分股名单不能拿来筛 2010 年的股票。
entries.why: 衡量数据诚实度的标准。
entries.plain_en: Only information that was actually available at the time. Today's index membership cannot be used to screen stocks in 2010.
entries.why_en: The standard for data honesty.

entries.plain: 用来挑选参数的那一段历史。它和『样本外』是分开的两块：挑选只能用训练段，成绩只能在样本外算。
entries.why: 挑参数只能用这段，碰另一段就作弊。
entries.plain_en: The part of history used to choose parameters. It is separate from the out-of-sample part: choose here, score there.
entries.why_en: Parameters may only be chosen on this slice. Touching the other slice is cheating.

entries.plain: 没有参与挑选的那一段数据。只有在它上面还能赚钱，才算有点东西。
entries.analogy: 平时做题（训练段）不算本事，期末闭卷考（样本外）才算。
entries.why: 本项目所有判定的核心。
entries.plain_en: Data that played no part in choosing the parameters. If it still works here, there may be something real.
entries.analogy_en: Practising at home proves nothing; the closed-book exam does.
entries.why_en: The core of every verdict in this project.

entries.plain: 见『样本外』。本项目固定留出 2021 年之后的数据，只在最后看一眼，不许反复调参。
entries.why: 改它等于销毁考卷。
entries.plain_en: See out-of-sample. Here: everything after 2021 is held back and looked at once, not repeatedly tuned against.
entries.why_en: Changing it is destroying the exam paper.

entries.plain: 滚动地做同一件事：用前面几年挑参数，用紧接着的那段检验，然后整体往前挪。这样能得到很多段互不重叠的成绩。
entries.analogy: 一边往后翻日历一边做预测，不许回头看答案。
entries.why: 时序验证器 tools/validate.py 的核心方法。
entries.plain_en: Rolling the same procedure forward: pick parameters on the past, test on what comes next, then shift the window. Produces many non-overlapping scores.
entries.analogy_en: Turning calendar pages and predicting as you go, with no peeking ahead.
entries.why_en: The method at the heart of tools/validate.py.

entries.plain: 把噪声当成了规律。回测里某个参数特别亮，可能只是那段时间的巧合。
entries.analogy: 看云看出人脸 —— 形状对上了，但云并不想长得像人。
entries.why: 本项目判定『不通过』最常见的原因。
entries.plain_en: Mistaking noise for a pattern. A parameter that looks brilliant in a backtest may just be a coincidence of that period.
entries.analogy_en: Seeing faces in clouds: the shape matches, but the cloud was not trying.
entries.why_en: The most common reason something is judged a failure here.

entries.plain: 反复试不同的参数/方向，直到有一次好看，然后只报告那次。试得越多，越容易撞上好运。
entries.analogy: 买 100 张彩票，中了就发朋友圈说『我有选号天赋』。
entries.why: 本项目用『预注册卡 + 账本』来防它。
entries.plain_en: Trying many parameters or directions until one looks good, then reporting only that one. The more tries, the better the best result looks.
entries.analogy_en: Buying 100 lottery tickets and posting the winner as evidence of talent.
entries.why_en: Countered here by pre-registered cards plus an append-only log.

entries.plain: 在做之前，把假设、参数、判定标准全部写下来并冻结。之后不许改。
entries.why: cards/ 目录下的每张卡就是一份预注册。
entries.plain_en: Writing the hypothesis, parameters and pass criteria down before running anything, then freezing them.
entries.why_en: Every card in cards/ is one.

entries.plain: 这个数字最可能落在哪个范围。区间是 [-3%, +12%]，说明结果可能就是 -3%，也可能是 12%。
entries.analogy: 天气预报说『明天降雨概率 60-80%』，比一个孤零零的『70%』诚实。
entries.why: 本项目的判定看区间下界：只有下界 > 0 才算有优势。
entries.plain_en: The range the true value most likely sits in. An interval of -3% to +12% means the answer may well be -3%.
entries.analogy_en: A forecast of '60-80% chance of rain' is more honest than a bare '70%'.
entries.why_en: Verdicts read the lower bound: only above zero counts as an edge.

entries.plain: 这个结果离『纯属碰巧』有多远。t 越大越不可能是巧合。常见门槛是 2 —— 大约相当于 5% 的概率是碰巧。
entries.analogy: 离平均分有几个标准差。
entries.why: 报告和判定里反复出现。
entries.plain_en: How far the result sits from 'pure coincidence'. Bigger t, less likely luck. Two is the usual bar, roughly a 5% chance of coincidence.
entries.analogy_en: How many standard deviations away from the average you are.
entries.why_en: Appears throughout the reports and verdicts.

entries.plain: 如果真相是『完全没效果』，那看到这么好结果的概率是多少。p 越小越不像巧合。
entries.analogy: 如果硬币是公平的，连续扔出 10 个正面有多难。
entries.why: 和 t 值一体两面。
entries.plain_en: If the truth were 'no effect at all', the chance of seeing something this good. Smaller is less like luck.
entries.analogy_en: How unlikely ten heads in a row is with a fair coin.
entries.why_en: The other side of the same coin as t.

entries.plain: 这个结果是不是不太可能纯属碰巧。通常 p < 0.05 叫『显著』。
entries.why: 项目里所有的『通过』都要求显著。
entries.plain_en: Whether the result is unlikely to be pure coincidence. Conventionally p below 0.05 is called significant.
entries.why_en: Every pass in this project requires it.

entries.plain: 试的次数一多，总有一次会碰巧好看。所以要按试过的次数提高门槛。
entries.analogy: 一百个人各猜一次股票，总有一个猜对，这不代表他会选股。
entries.why: 本项目试 12 个回看期，就要按 12 次来折算门槛。
entries.plain_en: Try enough things and one will look good by accident, so the bar has to rise with the number of tries.
entries.analogy_en: A hundred people each guess a stock; one is right, which proves nothing.
entries.why_en: This project tries 12 lookbacks, so the bar is adjusted for 12.

entries.plain: 多重检验最保守的校正方法：试了 N 次，就把门槛除以 N（等价地把 p 值乘 N）。
entries.why: cs_audit 用它折算『最亮的那个格子里有多少是搜索出来的』。
entries.plain_en: The most conservative fix for multiple testing: with N tries, divide the threshold by N (equivalently multiply the p-value by N).
entries.why_en: cs_audit uses it to discount how much of the best cell is just searching.

entries.plain: 把『你一共试了多少次』算进去之后的夏普比率。试得越多，同样的成绩就越不稀奇。
entries.why: 时序验证器用它防止『试了 20 组参数挑最好』。
entries.plain_en: A Sharpe ratio that accounts for how many variants you tried. The more attempts, the less impressive the same number.
entries.why_en: The time-series validator uses it to defuse 'tried 20 parameter sets, kept the best'.

entries.plain: 把数据的顺序打乱、重算一次，重复几百次，看真实值在这个『纯运气分布』里有多罕见。
entries.analogy: 把同一副牌洗几百次，看看你刚拿到的那手牌有多难得。
entries.why: 结构画像用它给方差比算 z 值 —— 固定阈值会把随机游走误判成趋势。
entries.plain_en: Shuffle the data, recompute, repeat hundreds of times, and see how rare the real value is in that distribution of pure luck.
entries.analogy_en: Shuffling the same deck hundreds of times to see how unusual the hand you drew really is.
entries.why_en: The structural profile uses it for a z-score: fixed thresholds misclassified random walks as trends.

entries.plain: 观察值离『纯运气平均』有几个标准差。超过 2 才算不像运气。
entries.why: 结构画像里 |z| > 2 才判有结构。
entries.plain_en: How many standard deviations the observation sits from the 'pure luck' average. Beyond 2 starts to look unlike luck.
entries.why_en: The profile requires |z| above 2 before calling anything a structure.

entries.plain: 今天的涨跌跟昨天还有没有关系。正数表示有惯性（顺着走），负数表示会回吐（来回摆），接近 0 表示没记忆。
entries.analogy: 昨天的天气对今天有没有参考价值。
entries.why: 结构画像的第一项指标。
entries.plain_en: Whether today's move remembers yesterday's. Positive means momentum, negative means it gives back, near zero means no memory.
entries.analogy_en: Whether yesterday's weather tells you anything about today's.
entries.why_en: First metric in the structural profile.

entries.plain: 把 20 天的波动和 1 天的波动比一比。大于 1 说明波动会越滚越大（趋势），小于 1 说明波动会被吃掉（回归）。
entries.why: 结构画像的 VR20。注意它本身噪声很大，必须看 z 值。
entries.plain_en: 20-day variance divided by one-day variance. Above 1 means swings compound (trending), below 1 means they get eaten (reverting).
entries.why_en: VR20 in the profile. Noisy on its own, which is why the z-score is what matters.

entries.plain: 涨的继续涨、跌的继续跌。买过去涨得好的票。
entries.why: 截面策略的一种方向。
entries.plain_en: What went up keeps going up, what fell keeps falling. Buy past winners.
entries.why_en: One of the two directions a cross-section can test.

entries.plain: 涨多了会跌回来、跌多了会涨回去。跟动量正好相反。
entries.why: A 股数据里更常见的方向。
entries.plain_en: What ran up comes back, what fell bounces. The opposite of momentum.
entries.why_en: The more common direction in the A-share data here.

entries.plain: 见『均值回归』。本项目里 direction=reversal 就是买过去跌得最狠的。
entries.why: HK-001 试的就是这个方向。
entries.plain_en: See mean reversion. direction = reversal here means buying the worst past performers.
entries.why_en: The direction HK-001 tested.

entries.plain: 同一时点上，横向比较一堆票谁强谁弱 —— 而不是盯着单只票猜它明天涨不涨。
entries.analogy: 不是预测某个学生下次考多少，而是给全班排名。
entries.why: 截面检验器的工作方式，样本量比单标的时序大一个数量级。
entries.plain_en: Comparing many tickers at the same moment, instead of guessing one ticker's next move.
entries.analogy_en: Rather than predicting one student's next score, rank the whole class.
entries.why_en: How the cross-sectional validator works: an order of magnitude more observations than one time series.

entries.plain: 你的排名和下一期实际涨跌的排名，有多一致。1 是完全一致，0 是毫无关系。-1 是完全相反。0.05 左右就已经有点用了。
entries.analogy: 你给全班排的名次，和下个月考试名次的相关度。
entries.why: 判定截面策略有没有预测力的核心指标。
entries.plain_en: How well your ranking matches the next period's actual ranking. 1 is perfect, 0 unrelated, -1 perfectly inverted. Around 0.05 already has some use.
entries.analogy_en: How closely your class ranking matches the next exam's ranking.
entries.why_en: The core measure of whether a cross-sectional signal predicts anything.

entries.plain: 这个策略最多能装多少钱。资金一大，买卖本身就会把价格推走。
entries.why: 小资金的优势区就在这里 —— 大基金进不去的小票，你能进。
entries.plain_en: The most money a strategy can absorb. Push more through and your own orders move the price.
entries.why_en: Where small capital has an advantage: names too small for large funds.

entries.plain: 拿历史数据把一套规则重放一遍，看它当时会赚还是会亏。它只能说明『过去会怎样』，不能说明『以后会怎样』。
entries.analogy: 用去年的考题模拟考一次 —— 分数有参考价值，但题目会换。
entries.why: 本项目所有结论都来自回测，所以我们反复强调『样本外』。
entries.plain_en: Replaying a rule on historical data to see what it would have done. It describes the past, not the future.
entries.analogy_en: A mock exam using last year's paper: useful, but the questions change.
entries.why_en: Every result here comes from one, which is why out-of-sample matters so much.

entries.plain: 见『夏普比率』。常被简写成夏普，指的是同一个东西：每承担一份波动，换来多少收益。
entries.why: 报告里大量出现简写。
entries.plain_en: Short for Sharpe ratio: return per unit of wobble.
entries.why_en: Reports use the short form a lot.

entries.plain: 把最近 N 天的收盘价取平均，连成一条线。它的作用是抹平日常噪音，让趋势更容易看出来。
entries.analogy: 把每天的体重记下来取周平均，比看单日数字更容易看出增减趋势。
entries.why: 本项目的双均线策略用 MA5 和 MA20。
entries.plain_en: The average closing price over the last N days, drawn as a line. Its job is to smooth daily noise so the trend is visible.
entries.analogy_en: Weekly averages of daily weigh-ins show the trend that single days hide.
entries.why_en: The dual moving-average strategy uses MA5 and MA20.

entries.plain: 短均线从下往上穿过长均线，常被当成『开始走强』的信号。
entries.analogy: 短期情绪开始超过长期平均。
entries.why: 双均线策略的买入信号。
entries.plain_en: The short moving average crosses above the long one; often read as 'starting to strengthen'.
entries.analogy_en: Short-term sentiment overtaking the long-term average.
entries.why_en: The buy signal of the MA strategy.

entries.plain: 短均线从上往下穿过长均线，常被当成『开始走弱』的信号。
entries.why: 双均线策略的卖出信号。
entries.plain_en: The short moving average crosses below the long one; often read as 'starting to weaken'.
entries.why_en: The sell signal of the MA strategy.

entries.plain: A 股单日涨幅达到上限（主板 10%、创业板/科创板 20%），到了上限就买不进。
entries.analogy: 演唱会门票一秒售空 —— 你想买也买不到。
entries.why: 回测若假设『想买就买得到』，会系统性高估收益。
entries.plain_en: A-shares stop trading at a daily gain cap (10% main board, 20% ChiNext/STAR). At the cap you cannot buy.
entries.analogy_en: Concert tickets sold out in a second: you cannot get in.
entries.why_en: A backtest that assumes 'you can always buy' systematically overstates returns.

entries.plain: A 股单日跌幅达到下限，到了下限就卖不出。
entries.why: 急着止损却卖不掉，是 A 股回测最容易忽略的现实。
entries.plain_en: The daily loss cap. At the cap you cannot sell.
entries.why_en: Wanting to stop out and being unable to is the reality A-share backtests ignore most often.

entries.plain: 股票临时停止交易，这段时间没有成交，行情软件里也常常没有当天的行。
entries.why: 数据里缺了这些天，指标窗口会错位。
entries.plain_en: The stock stops trading; often there is no bar at all in the data.
entries.why_en: Missing days misalign every indicator window.

entries.plain: A 股当天买入的股票，当天不能卖出，最快第二天才能卖。
entries.analogy: 今天借的书，明天才能还。
entries.why: 所以本项目的成交假设是『信号次日开盘成交』，正好符合 T+1。
entries.plain_en: Shares bought today cannot be sold until the next day.
entries.analogy_en: A library book borrowed today can be returned tomorrow.
entries.why_en: Why this project fills at next-day open, which matches T+1.

entries.plain: 先借股票卖出、等跌了再买回来还。方向反着赚钱。
entries.why: 本项目只做多，不做空 —— 做空的成本和风险对新手不友好。
entries.plain_en: Borrow shares, sell them, buy back cheaper, return them. Profits when the price falls.
entries.why_en: This project is long-only: shorting costs and risks are not friendly to beginners.

entries.plain: 公司把利润分一部分给股东，通常以现金形式。分红当天股价会相应下调。
entries.why: 这正是需要『复权』的原因。
entries.plain_en: A company paying part of its profit to shareholders, usually cash. The price drops by roughly the same amount on the ex-date.
entries.why_en: Exactly why price adjustment is needed.

entries.plain: 把一股拆成几股（比如 1 拆 4），股价相应变成四分之一。总市值不变。
entries.analogy: 把一张 100 元换成 4 张 25 元，钱没变。
entries.why: 不处理拆股，价格序列会出现‘腰斩’式的假跳空。
entries.plain_en: One share becomes several (1-for-4), the price becomes a quarter. Total value unchanged.
entries.analogy_en: Changing a 100 note into four 25s: the money is the same.
entries.why_en: Unadjusted, a split looks like a fake 75% crash.

entries.plain: 你有多大比例的钱押在这笔交易上。全仓就是 100%，半仓就是 50%。
entries.why: 决策层就是决定『下多少仓位』的模块。
entries.plain_en: How much of your capital is on this trade. Full position is 100%, half is 50%.
entries.why_en: The decision layer exists to choose position size.

entries.plain: 见『训练段』。参与过挑选的那部分数据，在它上面取得的成绩必然偏好看。
entries.why: 报告里说『样本内/样本外』分开报，就是防止拿训练成绩当真相。
entries.plain_en: See training window. The slice used for choosing, where results are flattering by construction.
entries.why_en: Reports separate in-sample from out-of-sample so training scores are not mistaken for truth.

entries.plain: 见『波动率』。把日波动按一年折算，方便和收益率放在一起比较。
entries.why: 结构画像里每只票都会算。
entries.plain_en: See volatility: daily moves scaled to a year so they sit next to returns.
entries.why_en: Computed for every ticker in the profile.

entries.plain: 平均每天成交额。用来估算你的下单量会不会把价格砸动。
entries.why: 真实成本模型要考虑它，v1 还没做。
entries.plain_en: Average daily traded value, used to estimate whether your order size would move the price.
entries.why_en: A real cost model needs it; v1 does not have one yet.
